author: Азаров Владимир Сергеевич
selection: Among four-shot models with invalid rate <= 5%, maximize test Macro-F1, then minimize defect miss rate, then cost per 1000 images. Application set is untouched until selection.

hypotheses.H1: Mean paired four-shot minus zero-shot Macro-F1 across the three models is positive on the comparison set.
hypotheses.H2: Selected four-shot model achieves Macro-F1 >=0.70 and defect miss rate <=0.05 on the application set.

scope: Pilot study. No ViT training or parameter updates; visual in-context learning only. Source-group identity is inferred from the filename prefix before _Img.
execution_note: Initial concurrency 8, then 4 after provider rate limiting. Completed responses retained; failed preliminary attempts preserved separately. Gemini Flash Lite excluded before final comparison.
